en: Black‑and‑white postcard-style photograph of a large curved institutional building with many identical windows, stone base and stucco upper walls, fronted by a high stone wall and iron fence. At the center rear rises a tower with an onion‑shaped dome and clock, topped by a weather vane. In front is a cobblestone square or street where several adults and many children in early‑20th‑century clothing are walking or standing, some near a small circular fountain or planting area. The architecture is monumental and slightly baroque, suggesting a school or municipal building in a European city.
